characters.pageIntro: Meet the confirmed characters of Grand Theft Auto VI.

jason.name: Jason Duval
jason.description: Jason grew up around grifters and crooks. After a stint in the Army, he found himself in the Keys working for local drug runners and looking for an easier life.
jason.background: Jason grew up around grifters and crooks. After a stint in the Army trying to shake off his troubled teens, he found himself in the Keys doing what he knows best, working for local drug runners.
jason.personality: He wants an easy life, but things keep getting harder. His meeting with Lucia changes the stakes around him.
jason.situation: Jason is working in the Keys and becomes closely tied to Lucia and Brian’s circle.

lucia.name: Lucia Caminos
lucia.description: Fresh out of prison, Lucia is determined to change the odds in her favor and take control of the life she wants.
lucia.background: Lucia’s father taught her to fight from a young age. Fighting for her family landed her in the Leonida Penitentiary, and sheer luck got her out.
lucia.personality: Focused, determined and prepared to take matters into her own hands rather than wait for someone else to change her circumstances.
lucia.situation: Lucia is fresh out of prison and committed to a plan that could make the life she wants possible.

cal.name: Cal Hampton
cal.description: Jason’s friend and Brian’s associate, Cal prefers staying close to home while listening in on Coast Guard communications and private tabs.
cal.background: Cal spends much of his time at home, monitoring Coast Guard communications and private tabs while keeping close to Jason and Brian.
cal.personality: Paranoid, observant and more comfortable behind a screen than in the middle of trouble.
cal.situation: Cal remains part of Jason’s circle as their plans become larger.

brian.name: Brian Heder
brian.description: A classic drug runner from the golden age of smuggling in the Keys, Brian still moves product through his boat yard.
brian.background: Brian has been around the Keys long enough to let others do his dirty work. He operates through his boat yard and keeps Jason close by giving him a place to live.
brian.personality: Experienced, connected and comfortable making other people handle the difficult parts.
brian.situation: Brian lets Jason live rent-free at one of his properties in exchange for helping with local shakedowns.

boobie.name: Boobie Ike
boobie.description: A Vice City legend who built an empire that stretches from real estate to entertainment.
boobie.background: Boobie came up from the streets and built a broad business empire including real estate, a strip club and a recording studio.
boobie.personality: Established, confident and accustomed to operating at a scale larger than the street.
boobie.situation: Boobie is associated with Dre’Quan and Only Raw as their worlds intersect.

drequan.name: Dre’Quan Priest
drequan.description: A hustler building Only Raw while working with Boobie Ike and Real Dimez.
drequan.background: Dre’Quan is focused on turning Only Raw into something bigger and works within Boobie Ike’s orbit.
drequan.personality: Ambitious and business-minded, with music and street connections moving in parallel.
drequan.situation: Dre’Quan continues developing Only Raw alongside his associates.

realdimez.name: Real Dimez
realdimez.description: A music duo represented by Bae-Luxe and Roxy, operating as one profile in this companion.
realdimez.background: Real Dimez is the duo of Bae-Luxe and Roxy, connected to Dre’Quan’s music operation.
realdimez.personality: Performative, ambitious and focused on turning their music presence into opportunity.
realdimez.situation: The duo is part of the expanding network around Only Raw.

raul.name: Raul Bautista
raul.description: A seasoned bank robber whose experience makes him a dangerous and capable operator.
raul.background: Raul is an experienced criminal operator who brings planning and professional robbery experience into the wider Leonida underworld.
raul.personality: Confident, experienced and willing to take calculated risks.
raul.situation: Raul operates independently within the criminal world of Leonida.
